notes:
Completed in blue ballpoint. Thirty-two printed digits and forty-nine written answers, all agreeing with the unique solution.

It is here because of how it was found. Its grid could not be located at all: the contour traced round it came back a shade inside its own printed rule, and the score is the weakest of the twenty lines a grid must have, so the two outer rules falling outside the shape took the whole score to 0.11 against 0.35 needed. Two percent larger it scores 0.38 and straightens into the whole puzzle. It is the photograph that showed the fault was a rectification a hair out of place rather than a grid the detector could not see, and it is the one that would go back to being unreadable if that rescue were removed.

One of the set sent in by another reader, so the only copy is the one that arrived: 1600 by 900, a fifth of the resolution it was taken at.
